verdict.summary: The change is documentation-only and correctly updates the workflow overview to match the existing fail-closed two-phase enrollment implementation: account registration remains pending, the scoped policy grant is proposed through a checked account-pool branch PR, and activation occurs only after merge. It removes the stale claim that the current implementation writes directly to master via a contents-API CAS. No trust check, permission, executable control flow, or test is changed, and the added text contains no reviewer-directed instruction.
